integrity: The source Proposition 1(iii) and Remark 2 were inspected in the full arXiv text, including the affine rho-dependence and the qualitative statement that a finite minimizer may exist. The proof differentiates exactly and treats all boundary cases; the bundled checker only replays representative instances.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes the published fixed-horizon translation upper bound under a rho-independent Lipschitz certificate. It does not optimize empirical error, prescribe within-run variation of rho, or cover cases where the relevant Lipschitz certificate itself varies with rho.
title: Exact penalty tuning for surrogate bilevel rate translation
